summary.intent: Complete GSD phase planning for CipherBox phase 70.1 (rotation read-plane durability and deep crash-resume soundness) by verifying the 13 generated plans, passing the blocking decision-coverage gate, and recording planning completion in STATE.md/ROADMAP.
summary.outcome: Plan-checker passed 13/13 with only a cosmetic warning; the decision-coverage gate initially failed due to malformed D-09/D-10 bullet formatting in CONTEXT.md, which was fixed and re-verified at 17/17 covered; STATE.md's automated update tool no-op'd so the state transition was applied manually, and the CONTEXT fix plus STATE update were committed.

repo: GSD's decision-coverage gate parser (extractDecisions) only accepts three D-NN bullet forms: `- **D-NN:** text`, `- **D-NN — title** body`, or `- **D-NN: Title.** body`; a single non-conforming bullet (e.g. `- **D-NN (title).** body` with period-then-closing-bold) causes the gate to bail on ALL decisions (0/N covered), not just the offending one.

CipherBox phase 70.1 CONTEXT.md had legacy discuss-phase D-NN bullets (D-09, D-10) using an older `(title).` format that predates the current parser's accepted syntax — worth checking other phase CONTEXT.md files for the same legacy formatting before their gates run.
workflow: GSD's `state.planned-phase` STATE-update tool can silently no-op (`"updated": []`) when it doesn't find its expected anchor fields in STATE.md, printing a false 'updated' confirmation — always verify STATE.md content after calling it rather than trusting the echoed success message, and be ready to hand-edit STATE.md as a fallback.

The ROADMAP annotate-waves tool also returned `updated: false` (no cross-cutting waves detected) — treated as an expected non-blocking outcome given 7 waves with no cross-cutting dependencies, not another instance of tool fragility.

friction: Decision-coverage gate is blocking but its failure message ('0/15 covered, one or more bullets malformed') didn't identify which bullet was malformed — required manually reading the parser source and testing every `**D-` bullet against its three accepted regexes to isolate D-09/D-10.

`state.planned-phase` tool reported success ('updated') but STATE.md was unchanged, discovered only via a follow-up verification check — this is the same STATE-format fragility class noted in memory ([[feedback-gsd-phase-complete-false-warning]] and prior GSD tool issues), required manual Read+Edit of STATE.md to correct.
open_items: ROADMAP wave-dependency annotation returned `updated: false` (no cross-cutting waves) — left as-is, non-blocking, not investigated further.
Post-planning gap analysis was kicked off in the final commit step but its result isn't shown in the transcript — worth confirming it completed cleanly before starting phase execution.
